name: native-mode-reaches-settings-and-hint
description: Reads a token off the settings document and off the hint bubble's own /hint document with Native app view off, then again after turning it on in the running app. The hint tokens must change. Settings must be native both times, since it is always native. The hint document only exists once a hint has shown (HintOverlayWidget builds lazily), so the scenario raises one via a real row hold before the toggle (mode off) and again after (mode on), the same trigger hint-shows-on-a-held-row.json uses. Settings is read before/after the same toggle, the technique a sibling scenario's scenario already proved for the command bar.

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot

actions.expression: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.row.tabrow'); if (!row) { return 'no-row'; } const r = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width / 2; const cy = r.top + r.height / 2; row.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', {clientX: cx, clientY: cy, bubbles: true})); return 'pressed'; })()

actions.expected: Hold to open in a peek

actions.expression: (() => { const r = document.documentElement; const s = getComputedStyle(r); const t = (n) => (s.getPropertyValue(n) || '').trim().toLowerCase(); return 'surround=' + t('--atrium-surround-color') + ' native=' + r.classList.contains('atrium-native-chrome'); })()

(() => { const row = document.querySelector('.row.tabrow'); if (!row) { return 'no-row'; } const r = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width / 2; const cy = r.top + r.height / 2; row.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', {clientX: cx, clientY: cy, bubbles: true})); return 'released'; })()
